q: Which Indian state has the longest coastline?
e: Gujarat has the longest coastline of any Indian state, along the Arabian Sea and its gulfs.

q: Which important line of latitude passes through Gujarat?
e: The Tropic of Cancer (about 23.5 degrees N) passes through northern Gujarat.

q: Which is the highest mountain in Gujarat?
e: Girnar near Junagadh, with its Gorakhnath peak, is the highest point in Gujarat.

q: Saputara, the hill station in Dang district, lies on which mountain range?
e: Saputara is on the Sahyadri range, the northern extension of the Western Ghats into Gujarat.

q: Surat city stands on the bank of which river?
e: Surat is located on the Tapi river close to its mouth.

q: Ahmedabad is situated on the bank of which river?
e: Ahmedabad was founded on the eastern bank of the Sabarmati.

q: Which river crosses the Tropic of Cancer twice in its course?
e: The Mahi rises in Madhya Pradesh and loops through Rajasthan, crossing the Tropic of Cancer twice before entering Gujarat.

q: The Sardar Sarovar Dam is built on which river?
e: The Sardar Sarovar Dam is on the Narmada at Kevadia (Ekta Nagar) in Narmada district.

q: Ukai Dam is constructed on which river?
e: Ukai Dam on the Tapi is one of the largest reservoirs of Gujarat.

q: Kadana Dam is built on which river?
e: Kadana Dam is on the Mahi river in Mahisagar district.

q: Which is the longest river of the Saurashtra region?
e: The Bhadar, flowing west through Rajkot, Junagadh and Porbandar districts, is the longest river of Saurashtra.

q: Gir National Park is the only natural home in the world of which animal?
e: The Gir forest of Saurashtra is the last natural habitat of the Asiatic lion.

q: Velavadar National Park, famous for blackbucks, is in which district?
e: Velavadar Blackbuck National Park lies in Bhavnagar district near the Gulf of Khambhat.

q: The Indian Wild Ass Sanctuary is located in:
e: The Little Rann of Kutch sanctuary protects the Indian wild ass (ghudkhar).

q: India's first Marine National Park was declared in:
e: The Marine National Park in the Gulf of Kutch, off Jamnagar, was declared in 1982 and is India's first.

q: Nal Sarovar, a Ramsar site and bird sanctuary, lies closest to which city?
e: Nal Sarovar is on the Ahmedabad-Surendranagar district border, about 60 km from Ahmedabad.

q: Which is the largest district of Gujarat by area?
e: Kutch is Gujarat's largest district and also the largest district of India by area.

q: The Kathiawar (Saurashtra) peninsula lies between which two gulfs?
o: Gulf of Khambhat and Gulf of Mannar
Gulf of Kutch and Gulf of Mannar
Gulf of Kutch and Gulf of Khambhat
Gulf of Khambhat and Bay of Bengal
e: Saurashtra is bounded by the Gulf of Kutch in the north-west and the Gulf of Khambhat in the east.

q: Alang, known for one of the world's largest ship-breaking yards, is in which district?
e: Alang lies on the Gulf of Khambhat coast in Bhavnagar district.

q: Deendayal Port in Kutch was earlier known as:
e: Kandla Port was renamed Deendayal Port in 2017.

q: Asia's first Export Processing Zone was set up in 1965 at:
e: The Kandla Free Trade Zone, established in 1965, was the first Export Processing Zone in Asia.

q: The Ambaji temple is situated in which hill range?
e: Ambaji in Banaskantha district lies in the Arasur hills, part of the Aravalli range.

q: Which state does NOT share a border with Gujarat?
e: Gujarat borders Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra; Goa is far to the south.

q: Which region of Gujarat receives the least rainfall?
e: Kutch has an arid to semi-arid climate and the lowest rainfall in the state, while the south is the wettest.

q: Gujarat is India's leading producer of which commodity, much of it from the Rann of Kutch and coastal pans?
e: Gujarat produces the bulk of India's salt from its coastal salt pans and the Rann.

q: Sir Creek, a disputed tidal estuary on the India-Pakistan border, is in which district?
e: Sir Creek lies in the marshes of Kutch between Gujarat and Sindh.

q: Jessore Wildlife Sanctuary, known for sloth bears, is in which district?
e: Jessore Sloth Bear Sanctuary lies in Banaskantha district near the Rajasthan border.

q: Which river flows through the Gir forest and has the Kamleshwar dam built on it?
e: The Hiran rises in the Gir hills; the Kamleshwar dam on it is a key water source for Gir's wildlife.

q: The Statue of Unity stands on which river island?
e: It stands on Sadhu Bet in the Narmada, a short distance downstream of the Sardar Sarovar Dam.

q: Where was oil first struck in Gujarat in 1958?
e: ONGC discovered oil at Lunej near Khambhat in 1958; the Ankleshwar field followed in 1960.
